surface: User-requested standalone scientific figures (PNG, SVG and PDF), rendered with existing Matplotlib environment; source figures for manuscript, not a new HTML application.
palette_policy: hard two-root cap: blue #3478B8 for full-context cached baseline, gold #C99024 for sliced cached candidate; charcoal text, neutral grids. Hatches and direct labels distinguish arms without color.
branding: Third-party project manuscript; no provider blossom or other implied institutional endorsement.

charts.question: Does either arm meet the predeclared 95% quality gate?
charts.takeaway: Each observed model and case must clear its own unchanged quality threshold; pooled counts expose all offered outputs and do not create independent samples.
charts.type: Grouped zero-based bars with a 95% reference line
charts.data: tables/cases.csv; numerator and full offered denominator per arm. Each development case has 16 native outputs per arm, comprising two repetitions of eight unique tasks; no confidence intervals.
charts.footprint: Width adapts to case count; 5.5 inches high
charts.qa: Inspect the exported PNG at native size for labels, threshold placement, denominator and absence of an unsupported efficiency claim.

charts.question: How does actual prefix reuse change cold, warm and full-table new-token work?
charts.takeaway: Cold and warm histories can point in different directions. All-query totals always retain first-use work.
charts.type: Three zero-based bar panels: first-use new tokens, mean subsequent-query new tokens, total new tokens per attempt
charts.data: tables/requests.csv and tables/attempts.csv; all observed native counters, averaged across the retained repetitions. First-use requests and table transitions remain included.
charts.qa: Panel denominators and different y scales are explicit; no timing or API-price equivalence is implied.

charts.question: Do service observations translate to full attempt cost differences?
charts.takeaway: Service and other charged attempt work stay visible separately; a quality failure prevents an efficiency claim regardless of timing direction.
charts.type: Stacked zero-based bars for service and remaining attempt wall, grouped by balanced pair
charts.data: tables/attempts.csv; individual attempts and complete costs, without omissions or hypothetically pooled cache histories.
charts.qa: Service plus remaining work exactly sum to full attempt wall; pair labels and AB/BA producer order are clear. Failed states remain in the analysis.

charts.question: Does warm-token reversal recur across new tables, and which harmful, beneficial and shared correctness outcomes accompany it?
charts.takeaway: Display every retained table and both balanced repetitions, keeping all four correctness classes and the unchanged eligibility decision visible.
charts.type: Two thin bars per table for subsequent-query slice-minus-full new-token work, alongside two stacked eight-task correctness-class bars per table.
charts.data: tables/tables.csv; each held-out case has 16 table groups and two balanced repetitions. First-use work remains in the other figures and full accounting.
charts.qa: All table indices and both repetitions are present; stacked classes sum to eight; warm-delta signs agree with raw-derived counter totals. No independent-query uncertainty or quality-qualified efficiency claim after ineligibility.
